name: Assets
meaning: Root of everything the company owns or controls.

name: Cash and cash equivalents
meaning: Money on hand and in banks.

name: Cash on hand
meaning: Notes and coins held by the company.

name: Cash in bank
meaning: Balances on demand bank accounts.

name: Cash in transit
meaning: Money sent but not yet credited to the receiving account.

name: Receivables
meaning: Amounts others owe the company.

name: Trade receivables
meaning: Amounts customers owe for goods and services, by open item; customer advances are open items on the credit side.

name: Intercompany receivables
meaning: Amounts owed by other companies or dependent units of the same group, by open item.

name: Employee advances
meaning: Money advanced to employees and not yet settled, by open item.

name: Loans granted
meaning: Loans the company has granted to others, one open item per contract once the loan subledger is active (ADR-0025).

name: Other receivables
meaning: Receivables from partners that are not trade, intercompany or employee advances.

name: Allowance for doubtful receivables
meaning: Reduces receivables to the amount expected to be collected.

name: Shortages pending decision
meaning: Assets found missing whose treatment is not yet decided.

name: Tax receivables
meaning: Taxes the company may deduct or reclaim.

name: Input tax
meaning: Value-added or sales tax paid on purchases that may be deducted.

name: Other tax receivables
meaning: Taxes paid in advance or reclaimable other than input tax.

name: Inventory
meaning: Goods and materials the company owns.

name: Goods in transit
meaning: Goods the company owns that have not yet arrived.

name: Raw materials
meaning: Materials to be used in production.

name: Tools and supplies
meaning: Tools and supplies held in stock.

name: Finished goods
meaning: Products the company made and holds for sale.

name: Merchandise
meaning: Goods bought for resale.

name: Goods sent
meaning: Goods delivered to customers or agents and still owned by the company.

name: Other inventory
meaning: Stock the company owns that no other inventory account covers.

name: Work in process
meaning: Cost of unfinished production.

name: Inventory write-down allowance
meaning: Reduces inventory to its net realizable value.

name: Prepaid expenses
meaning: Costs paid for later periods and spread over them.

name: Deposits paid
meaning: Deposits and collateral the company has placed with others.

name: Financial investments
meaning: Securities, term deposits and investments in other entities.

name: Investments in group companies
meaning: Investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates.

name: Other financial investments
meaning: Securities, term deposits and other investments.

name: Investment loss allowance
meaning: Reduces financial investments for expected losses.

name: Fixed assets
meaning: Long-lived assets used in the business.

name: Tangible fixed assets
meaning: Cost of buildings, machines, vehicles and equipment.

name: Intangible fixed assets
meaning: Cost of land use rights, software, licenses and similar rights.

name: Investment property
meaning: Property held to earn rent or for capital gain.

name: Other fixed assets
meaning: Long-lived assets no other fixed asset account covers.

name: Accumulated depreciation
meaning: Total depreciation and amortization of fixed assets.

name: Construction in progress
meaning: Cost of assets being built or acquired and not yet in use.

name: Deferred tax assets
meaning: Income tax recoverable in later periods.

name: Other assets
meaning: Assets not covered by another system account.

name: Currency exchange clearing
meaning: Technical account between the two sides of a currency exchange; zero per document in company and group currency, never revalued (ADR-0048 rule 12).

name: Liabilities
meaning: Root of everything the company owes.

name: Payables
meaning: Amounts the company owes others.

name: Trade payables
meaning: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, by open item; advances to suppliers are open items on the debit side.

name: Intercompany payables
meaning: Amounts owed to other companies or dependent units of the same group, by open item.

name: Payables to employees
meaning: Salaries and other amounts owed to employees.

name: Social contributions payable
meaning: Social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and union fees owed.

name: Deposits received
meaning: Deposits and collateral others have placed with the company.

name: Other payables
meaning: Payables to partners that no other payable account covers.

name: Surpluses pending decision
meaning: Assets found in excess whose treatment is not yet decided.

name: GR/IR clearing
meaning: Goods received not yet invoiced and invoices received for goods not yet received.

name: Purchase cost clearing
meaning: Purchase and landed costs recorded and not yet allocated to receipts or consumers (DS-11).

name: Taxes payable
meaning: Taxes and charges owed to the state.

name: Output tax
meaning: Value-added or sales tax charged on sales.

name: Import VAT or sales tax payable
meaning: Value-added or sales tax owed on imported goods.

name: Import and export duties payable
meaning: Customs duties owed on goods imported or exported.

name: Excise tax payable
meaning: Special consumption or excise tax owed.

name: Corporate income tax payable
meaning: Income tax the company owes.

name: Personal income tax payable
meaning: Income tax withheld from employees and others and owed to the state.

name: Other taxes payable
meaning: Taxes, fees and charges owed that no other tax account covers.

name: Accrued expenses
meaning: Costs incurred but not yet invoiced or paid.

name: Unearned revenue
meaning: Amounts received for revenue of later periods.

name: Borrowings
meaning: Loans received, bonds issued and finance lease liabilities.

name: Provisions
meaning: Liabilities of uncertain timing or amount.

name: Deferred tax liabilities
meaning: Income tax payable in later periods.

name: Other liabilities
meaning: Liabilities not covered by another system account.

name: Equity
meaning: Root of the owners' interest in the company.

name: Owner capital
meaning: Capital contributed by the owners.

name: Share premium
meaning: Amounts received from owners above the par value of shares.

name: Treasury stock
meaning: Cost of the company's own shares bought back.

name: Exchange differences in equity
meaning: Exchange differences the accounting regime holds in equity before they reach profit or loss.

name: Retained earnings
meaning: Accumulated profit or loss not distributed.

name: Income summary
meaning: Technical closing account that collects income and expenses at period end and is zero after closing (DS-12).

name: Opening balance clearing
meaning: Technical account that balances opening entries during migration and is zero after it (DS-21).

name: Other equity
meaning: Reserves, funds and other equity items not covered by another system account.

name: Income
meaning: Root of all income.

name: Revenue
meaning: Income from selling goods and services.

name: Revenue from goods
meaning: Income from selling goods.

name: Revenue from services
meaning: Income from providing services.

name: Other revenue
meaning: Operating revenue not from goods or services sold.

name: Revenue deductions
meaning: Amounts deducted from revenue.

name: Trade discounts
meaning: Discounts granted to customers on the sales price.

name: Sales returns
meaning: Revenue of goods customers returned.

name: Sales allowances
meaning: Price reductions granted after sale for defects or other reasons.

name: Other revenue deductions
meaning: Deductions from revenue no other account covers.

name: Financial income
meaning: Income from financial activities.

name: Interest income
meaning: Interest earned.

name: Realized exchange gains
meaning: Exchange gains on settled foreign-currency items.

name: Unrealized exchange gains
meaning: Exchange gains from revaluing open foreign-currency items.

name: Other financial income
meaning: Financial income not covered by another account.

name: Rounding gains
meaning: Conversion rounding differences that increase profit (ADR-0006 rule 20).

name: Payment discounts received
meaning: Discounts suppliers grant for early payment.

name: Non-operating income
meaning: Income outside ordinary activities, such as gains on disposal of assets.

name: Other income
meaning: Income not covered by another system account.

name: Expenses
meaning: Root of all expenses.

name: Cost of goods sold
meaning: Cost of goods and services sold.

name: Production costs
meaning: Costs collected for production, settled to work in process or finished goods (ADR-0025).

name: Direct material costs
meaning: Materials consumed by a cost collector.

name: Direct labor costs
meaning: Labor charged to a cost collector.

name: Production overhead
meaning: Overhead charged or allocated to a cost collector.

name: Other production costs
meaning: Production costs not covered by another production cost account.

name: Inventory write-down expense
meaning: Expense from reducing inventory to net realizable value.

name: Inventory differences
meaning: Stock count and revaluation differences recognized in profit or loss (DS-09).

name: Price differences
meaning: Differences between invoice and receipt value not added to inventory.

name: Financial expenses
meaning: Expenses of financial activities.

name: Interest expense
meaning: Interest owed on borrowings.

name: Realized exchange losses
meaning: Exchange losses on settled foreign-currency items.

name: Unrealized exchange losses
meaning: Exchange losses from revaluing open foreign-currency items.

name: Other financial expenses
meaning: Financial expenses not covered by another account.

name: Rounding losses
meaning: Conversion rounding differences that reduce profit (ADR-0006 rule 20).

name: Payment discounts given
meaning: Discounts granted to customers for early payment.

name: Selling expenses
meaning: Costs of selling and distributing goods and services.

name: Administrative expenses
meaning: Costs of managing the company.

name: Non-operating expenses
meaning: Expenses outside ordinary activities, such as losses on disposal of assets.

name: Income tax expense
meaning: Current and deferred corporate income tax.

name: Other expenses
meaning: Expenses not covered by another system account.
